steps.description: The full email address for this account, e.g. office@gracechurch.org. Make sure the domain (the part after @) matches an Email Domain you have already created, since Frappe will pull server settings from that domain.
steps.label: Email Address
steps.title: Email Address

steps.description: A short label for this account, e.g. Office, Pastor Inbox, or Giving. This is how the account will appear in lists and selectors. It doesn't need to match the email address.
steps.label: Email Account Name
steps.title: Account Name

steps.description: Check this to pull messages from this mailbox into Frappe. Incoming emails appear in the Communication inbox and can be linked to records like Prayer Requests, People, and Letters. When you check it, Default Incoming appears. Tick that on the one account that gets mail addressed to no specific inbox.
steps.label: Enable Incoming
steps.title: Enable Incoming

steps.description: Check this to send mail through this account. Notifications, replies, and the "Send" button on Communications will use this account's SMTP credentials. When you check it, Default Outgoing appears. Tick that on the one account whose address is the From address when no account is chosen.
steps.label: Enable Outgoing
steps.title: Enable Outgoing

steps.description: Select the Email Domain you set up earlier. The incoming/outgoing server and port settings will be inherited from it, so you don't have to enter them again.
steps.label: Domain
steps.title: Domain

steps.description: The password for this mailbox. If your provider uses two-factor authentication (Gmail, Microsoft 365, etc.), generate an app password in your provider's security settings and use that here instead of your regular password.
steps.label: Password
steps.title: Password
